2\. Some recent merges trigger stall alarms 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
mission_merge examines only the first 100 closed pull requests sorted by update time. If
subsequent updates place at least 100 other closed requests ahead of a recent mission merge, the
watchdog omits that merge from progress and can alarm despite the completed work.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The watchdog can miss a recent mission merge outside the first page of closed pull requests. ## Fix Focus Areas - room.py[2830-2842] - room.py[3071-3078] ## Recommended Fix Page through closed pull requests until the relevant merge window has been covered, rather than filtering only the first response. Test with a mission merge displaced by more than 100 subsequently updated closed requests. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
